internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rates in Checkout Service
internal.body:
At 10:54 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis rounds identified error injection as a likely cause, with the payment service showing a 25% error rate and the checkout service showing a 23.75% error rate and increased latency. Multiple diagnosis attempts were made, but proposals to mitigate the issue were blocked by guardrails due to missing flags and dry run requirements. The incident was escalated for further investigation and resolution.

Timeline highlights:
- 10:54:01: Alert received for high error rate in checkout
- 11:13:40: Diagnosis round 1 focused on checkout error injection
- 11:13:54: Diagnosis round 2 focused on payment error injection
- 11:14:06: Diagnosis round 3 revisited checkout error injection
- Multiple proposals were refused due to guardrail constraints

The incident remains under investigation with escalated support involved.

external.body: Between 10:54 and 11:15 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing their checkout process. Our teams detected elevated error rates affecting the checkout service and are actively working to resolve the issue. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience as we work to restore full service.

output.root_cause: The root cause is under investigation. Initial findings indicate error injection in the payment and checkout services contributing to the elevated error rates, but no confirmed resolution was reached during the incident window.
output.resolution: The incident was escalated for further investigation and resolution. Mitigation proposals were blocked by guardrails, preventing immediate resolution during the incident window.

lessons.lesson: Ensure that all mitigation proposals have the necessary flags and dry run validations in place to avoid guardrail rejections during incident response.

action_items: Review and update guardrail configurations to allow necessary mitigation actions during incidents.
Enhance monitoring and alerting for error injection patterns in both checkout and payment services.
Conduct a post-incident review with the engineering teams to identify improvements in incident response workflows.
